title: Defending Large Language Models Against Jailbreak Exploits with Responsible AI Considerations
reasoning: The paper is centered on 'Responsible AI' principles and specifically investigates 'ethical reasoning' as an internal property of LLMs. It evaluates its defense strategies by using an LLM-based judge to produce binary verdicts of 'ethical compliance' against jailbreak benchmarks, aiming to prevent 'unethical behavior.'
